title: Sparkly anchor
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill="#ffe066">
    <!-- sparkle top-left -->
    <polygon points="22,16 24,22 30,24 24,26 22,32 20,26 14,24 20,22"/>
    <!-- sparkle top-right -->
    <polygon points="78,12 80,18 86,20 80,22 78,28 76,22 70,20 76,18"/>
    <!-- sparkle bottom-left -->
    <polygon points="16,74 18,80 24,82 18,84 16,90 14,84 8,82 14,80"/>
    <!-- sparkle bottom-right -->
    <polygon points="84,70 86,76 92,78 86,80 84,86 82,80 76,78 82,76"/>
    <!-- small sparkles -->
    <circle cx="34" cy="10" r="2.5"/>
    <circle cx="66" cy="90" r="2.5"/>
    <circle cx="90" cy="44" r="2"/>
    <circle cx="10" cy="56" r="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Anchor ring -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="18" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#ffcc33" stroke-width="3.5"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="18" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#ffe899" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Anchor shank -->
  <rect x="47.5" y="24" width="5" height="48" rx="2" fill="#ffcc33"/>
  <rect x="47.5" y="24" width="2" height="48" rx="1" fill="#ffe899"/>

  <!-- Anchor stock (crossbar) -->
  <rect x="30" y="34" width="40" height="6" rx="3" fill="#ff9933"/>
  <rect x="30" y="34" width="40" height="2.5" rx="1.25" fill="#ffcc66"/>

  <!-- Anchor crown and arms -->
  <path d="M50 72 
           C50 72 46 78 40 82 
           C32 87 24 84 24 78 
           L24 76 
           C24 74 26 73 28 74 
           L30 76 
           C32 78 36 79 40 77 
           C45 74 48 70 50 70 
           C52 70 55 74 60 77 
           C64 79 68 78 70 76 
           L72 74 
           C74 73 76 74 76 76 
           L76 78 
           C76 84 68 87 60 82 
           C54 78 50 72 50 72 Z"
        fill="#ffcc33"/>
  
  <!-- Extra highlight on crown -->
  <path d="M50 72 
           C50 72 46 78 40 82 
           C32 87 24 84 24 78 
           L24 76 
           C24 74 26 73 28 74 
           L30 76 
           C32 78 36 79 40 77 
           C45 74 48 70 50 70"
        fill="none" stroke="#ffe899" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Flukes (arrow tips on the ends of the arms) -->
  <!-- Left fluke -->
  <polygon points="22,73 16,66 24,68 26,76" fill="#ff9933"/>
  <!-- Right fluke -->
  <polygon points="78,73 84,66 76,68 74,76" fill="#ff9933"/>

  <!-- Small decorative dots on shank -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="46" r="2" fill="#ffe899"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="2" fill="#ffe899"/>
</svg>
